# Intercom API
The intercom API reference.

The european API server
```

```
The australian API server
```

```
## Security

Type: http
Scheme: bearer

## Admins
- [GET /me](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/identifyadmin.md): You can view the currently authorised admin along with the embedded app object (a "workspace" in legacy terminology). > 🚧 Single Sign On If you are building a custom "Log in with Intercom" flow for y
- [PUT /admins/{admin_id}/away](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/setawayadmin.md): You can set an Admin as away for the Inbox.
- [GET /admins/activity_logs](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/listactivitylogs.md): You can get a log of activities by all admins in an app.
- [POST /admins/activity_logs/search](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/searchactivitylogs.md): Search and filter admin activity logs using a POST request with event type filter in the request body. You can find more details about the available event types in the List all activity log event type
- [GET /admins/activity_log_event_types](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/listactivitylogeventtypes.md): You can get a list of all activity log event types. This is useful for discovering valid values to use with the `event_types` filter on the List all activity logs endpoint.
- [GET /admins](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/listadmins.md): You can fetch a list of admins for a given workspace.
- [GET /admins/{admin_id}](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/admins/retrieveadmin.md): You can retrieve the details of a single admin.

title: developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/calls/listcalls.md
snippet:
# List all calls
Retrieve a paginated list of calls.
Endpoint: GET /calls
Version: 2.16
Security: bearerAuth
## Query parameters:
- `page` (integer)
The page of results to fetch. Defaults to first page
- `per_page` (integer)
How many results to display per page. Defaults to 25. Max 25.

- `data.id` (string)
The id of the call.
Example: 123
- `data.conversation_id` (string)
The id of the conversation associated with the call, if any.
Example: 456
- `data.admin_id` (string)
The id of the admin associated with the call, if any.
Example: 789
- `data.contact_id` (string)
The id of the contact associated with the call, if any.
Example: 6762f0dd1bb69f9f2193bb83
- `data.state` (string)
The current state of the call.
Example: completed
- `data.initiated_at` (any)
- `data.recording_url` (string)
API URL to download or redirect to the call recording if available.
Example: https://api.intercom.io/calls/123/recording
- `data.transcription_url` (string)
API URL to download or redirect to the call transcript if available.
Example: https://api.intercom.io/calls/123/transcript
- `data.call_type` (string)
The type of call.
Example: phone
- `data.direction` (string)
The direction of the call.
Example: outbound
- `data.ended_reason` (string)
The reason for the call end, if applicable.
Example: completed
- `data.phone` (string)
The phone number involved in the call, in E.164 format.
Example: +15551234567
- `data.fin_recording_url` (string)
API URL to the AI Agent (Fin) call recording if available.
- `data.fin_transcription_url` (string)
API URL to the AI Agent (Fin) call transcript if available.

Everything about your contacts

title: Retrieve a conversation | Intercom and Fin Developer Platform
snippet:
#### Request
You can fetch the details of a single conversation.
This will return a single Conversation model with all its conversation parts.
Hard limit of 500 parts
The maximum number of conversation parts that can be returned via the API is 500. If you have more than that we will return the 500 most recent conversation parts.

##### Headers
Intercom-Version*string*[(intercom_version)](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/2.11/rest-api/api.intercom.io/models/intercom_version)
Intercom API version.
By default, it's equal to the version set in the app package.
Default:"2.11"
Enum:"1.0""1.1""1.2""1.3""1.4""2.0""2.1""2.2""2.3""2.4"
Example:2.11
- The production API server
https://api.intercom.io/conversations/{conversation_id}
- The european API server
https://api.eu.intercom.io/conversations/{conversation_id}
- The australian API server
https://api.au.intercom.io/conversations/{conversation_id}
```
curl -i -X GET \
'https://api.intercom.io/conversations/123?display_as=plaintext' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN_HERE>' \
-H 'Intercom-Version: 2.11'
```

title: Retrieve companies | Intercom and Fin Developer Platform
snippet:
#### Request
You can fetch a single company by passing in `company_id` or `name`.
`https://api.intercom.io/companies?name={name}`
`https://api.intercom.io/companies?company_id={company_id}`
You can fetch all companies and filter by `segment_id` or `tag_id` as a query parameter.
`https://api.intercom.io/companies?tag_id={tag_id}`
`https://api.intercom.io/companies?segment_id={segment_id}`
The list is paged by page number. There is a limit of 10,000 companies; beyond that the request returns a `400` error and you should use the scroll endpoint instead.

company_id*string*
The `company_id` of the company to filter by.
Example:company_id=12345
tag_id*string*
The `tag_id` of the company to filter by.
Example:tag_id=678910
segment_id*string*
The `segment_id` of the company to filter by.
Example:segment_id=98765
type*string*
Set to `user` or `users`, together with `company_id` or `name`, to return that company's users instead of the company. The response is then a `user.list` object with a `users` array in the legacy user format, paged with `page` and `per_page` (default 50).

##### Headers
- The production API server
https://api.intercom.io/companies
- The european API server
https://api.eu.intercom.io/companies
- The australian API server
https://api.au.intercom.io/companies
```
curl -i -X GET \
'https://api.intercom.io/companies?name=my%20company&company_id=12345&tag_id=678910&segment_id=98765&type=users&page=1&per_page=15' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN_HERE>' \
-H 'Intercom-Version: 2.18'
```
